steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I know where you're really from... <color=#fb9259>DisCity</color>.
The girl's firm fingers around Hella's arm are ice-cold.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Me? From DisCity? Are you kidding?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Those thugs in black are my enemies! You know... I won't even hesitate to kill them if I ever get a chance...!
Hella tries to back away as she speaks, but Hypatia pulls her away from the crowd to an empty corner.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But you arrived with those DisCity people. I saw you crossing the sandstorm together. They seemed friendly toward you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Th-that's because I was valuable cargo! They were trying to smuggle me to Outlands to sell for profit...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The Legion</color> doesn't engage in trafficking, nor do they allow strangers into their ranks. You must be one of them.
The girl drops this bombshell so casually that Hella nearly bites her own tongue in shock.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ?! How do you know about them...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: After the BR-002 incident, some people migrated from DisCity's West District to the outer satellite towns. But one group strayed, changing their course to head deep into WhiteSands, avoiding way stations and main routes as they traveled northwest.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: There's an undercover agent from the Minos Bureau in that group. A clever and cunning Sinner skilled at disguising their true identity.
No way, she knows about all that too?!
Hella tries to back away, but the blonde girl closes in again, gripping her hand even tighter until it begins to hurt.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: There's something only you guys can do. I'll release your friends, but in exchange...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: While there's still time, leave this place. Take everyone here and <color=#fb9259>escape from Furor</color>.
Escape from Furor? Take everyone? Why? Questions swirl through Hella's mind, but the most pressing issue right now is...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****! At least try to be nice when you're asking for a favor! Let go of my hand—you're gonna break it!!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Enough! Let go! I won't run away. Just finish what you were saying!

She hastily loosens her grip, but then clutches Hella's hand firmly again as if afraid she might escape. This time her hold isn't painful, just resolute. Hella tries to pull away, but has to reluctantly give up when she can't free herself.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's going on with Furor? Why do you want me to evacuate the town?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And what about that Apostle of Ashes... Weren't you able to destroy it? With that Aurum something thingy you have!
Hypatia lowers her gaze slightly and gently shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No, that only affected part of the Apostle. You see, it's a very cunning creature. The entirety of that storm you saw is its body. If we can't destroy it in one strike, the remaining parts will regenerate, making it nearly impossible to eradicate.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The entire storm is its body?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Therefore, you and your companions cannot remain here either and must leave quickly. I simply ask that when you go, you take everyone from this town with you.
The girl's tone is utterly sincere. But the intimidating pressure from earlier still lingers in Hella's mind as she scrutinizes Hypatia. She begins carefully.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Is that a threat? Or a demand?
A few seconds of silence pass. Hypatia lifts her head and meets Hella's gaze directly, speaking after some deliberation.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is... my request. As the leader of Furor, to the visitors from DisCity.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh? But I'm one of those evil bad guys from DisCity. What makes you think I'd agree?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I... have heard from my sources.
The girl's grip loosens slightly. There's an unexpected hint of a smile in her voice.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>He</color> said there's a petite Sinner in this crew venturing into WhiteSands, and that while she may appear like a brash loner, she's actually a fiercely loyal person who can't stand to see her friends suffer.
steps.female_content: <color=#fb9259>She</color> said there's a petite Sinner in this crew venturing into WhiteSands, and that while she may appear like a brash loner, she's actually a fiercely loyal person who can't stand to see her friends suffer.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: And that if I explain what's at stake and treat her with honesty, I'm certain to earn her help.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What are you talking about! Flattery won't get you anywhere! It's not like such a big crowd will just up and follow us DisCity folks without a good reason...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Your agreement alone would be a good start. Let me explain everything from the beginning.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Also, though it's rather late for introductions at this point, but...
The girl gently lets go of Hella's hand.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Pleased to meet you. My name is Hypatia. Hypatia Campbell of Fraser's Campbell family. I'm also the head of Furor's Aurum Secretum Laboratory and the inventor of Aurum Secretum instruments.
The tension surrounding them gradually dissipates, and Hella finally notices that beneath her formal exterior, Lady Campbell is nothing more than a gentle, soft-spoken girl.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm... um, Hella. Just call me Hella. I haven't got any fancy titles like yours, so just think of me as some heroic adventurer!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So anyway, what exactly do you need me to do?

Hypatia raises her right hand, guiding Hella's gaze upward. Beyond the shattered barrier, the sky-darkening black sand still lingers, howling and circling outside Furor like a predator watching its prey.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: As you can see, the storm surrounding Furor is actually a manifestation of the Apostle's presence. It's a projection of consciousness into reality, and its behavior is heavily influenced by the Mania field. However, because it's too dispersed, it will desperately migrate toward areas of high Mania concentration, seeking to swallow and merge with them, thereby maintaining an equilibrium.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Therefore, as long as the Apostle continues lurking outside Furor, this city will continue to be in danger.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Um... What?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Ahem, to put it simply, this Apostle is easily attracted to people with high spiritual power, especially powerful Sinners—like you and your friends in the Legion. The fluctuations created when you use your special powers attract the Apostle, which is why it relentlessly pursues you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Well damn, no wonder it kept chasing after us. So it's actually hungry for our power...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait, then if we're not here, or if we leave...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It would target the other residents in the city. After all, they also possess spiritual power.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What about Aurum Secretum then? Didn't you build some kickass barrier?
Hypatia shakes her head, her expression filled with dejection.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Aurum Secretum is not an omnipotent solution. The protective measures installed on the outer rock faces have been continuously eroding, and because they're difficult to recover, they eventually get devoured by the Apostle, becoming part of its body... It is <color=#fb9259>growing</color>, with Aurum Secretum serving as its nourishment.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The debris in the storm is made up of the things it has devoured. Rocks, sand, cities, passing life forms... These fragments are gathered together by the Apostle's Mania field, forming the black storm that blots out the sky.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Now it's trying to swallow Furor whole, slowly gnawing and digesting it...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Please, help Furor before time runs out.
She places her right hand over her chest and slightly bows her head, giving Hella a traditional salute that looks too formal and complicated.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Geez, get back up already! No need to be so formal. It's making me super uncomfortable. I never said I wouldn't help, I just don't understand what's going on here. Horo and the others are locked up somewhere below, and besides, what I don't get is...
Hella scratches her head and voices her confusion.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So, you seem pretty powerful to me. Can't you just help them escape yourself? Why do you need us to rescue them?
Hypatia seems about to respond when her expression suddenly changes.
Footsteps approach. Someone is humming a tune while walking directly toward the quiet corner they're in, coming with a clear purpose and making no attempt to conceal their presence.
Hypatia pulls Hella backward toward the rock wall and quickly runs her fingers over the surface, searching for something...
Click. The sound of a mechanism getting activated. A stone door slides open, revealing a passageway barely half a person's height.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wow, Furor has secret passages too? That's so cool... Hey wait, don't drag me like this! And stop shoving me, I'm gonna fall...?!
[Background: Inside the Coffin]
The blonde girl forcefully shoves Hella into the secret passage. In an instant, the stone door closes, plunging the cave into darkness. Only faint rays of light filter through a few air holes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hypatia?! What are you doing!
Hypatia's hushed voice filters through the air holes.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Shh, be quiet. Don't say a word.
The light dims as the person outside blocks part of the openings. Despite this, Hella can't resist edging forward to peer through the one remaining hole...
[Background: City Center]
Hypatia stands blocking the entrance. Though Hella can't see her face, she senses that Hypatia has slipped back into that cold, rigid demeanor from before.
A moment later, a figure rounds the corner, approaching with a leisurely gait before offering an awkward bow.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Campbell messenger <color=#fb9259>Synex</color>, at your service. It's been a while, my lady.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I just visited your residence, but your servants informed me you had gone out. You've led me on quite a chase. Heh, if you needed a diversion, surely you could have chosen somewhere less... squalid?
Hypatia's hands, clasped behind her back, tighten slightly. Is she... nervous?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Just testing some new Aurum Secretum equipment.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What do you want? The Furor project is progressing well. I'll submit all the materials the family requires on schedule. No additional support is needed.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Is that so? Well, I've heard that... a group from DisCity has just recently arrived. What do you say? Would you like me to help you... clean up your current home?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: They're just a small group of refugees from DisCity. I've already handled it. They'll be leaving tomorrow.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Did you come all this way for this trivial matter? The Campbell family's shadow operative seem to have far too much free time.
The woman who's just been called a shadow operative tilts her head slightly, speaking pretentiously.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Trying to dismiss me so soon? I haven't even mentioned my actual business yet. Regarding the proposal you submitted previously, <color=#fb9259>a special someone</color> has sent me to personally deliver the family's decision.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Of course, I'm well aware of your exceptional competence, my lady. No petty thief could ever escape your notice. But with research as important as yours, someone needs to come specifically to help clear away troubles and solve problems. For instance...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: —Catching little mice that love to eavesdrop!
Hella clamps her hand over her mouth, desperately fighting back the scream rising in her throat.
Less than a centimeter from her face, Synex's blade has struck deep into the rock, barely missing Hella.
[Background: City Center]
The long-handled dagger plunges deep into the rock beside Hypatia. Without flinching, she reaches out and pulls the weapon free.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Are you questioning my loyalty? Or perhaps suggesting my lab has been compromised?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Before you can give a solid answer, I'd appreciate it if you didn't damage my city so carelessly. As for other matters... there are too many pairs of ears around us. Let's continue this discussion back at the lab.
The masked woman shrugs with a grin, retrieves her weapon, and walks away with Hypatia.
Meanwhile, the little mouse who should have been exterminated...
After making sure both of them have actually left, Hella finally releases the breath she's been holding.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Almost gave me a heart attack! Ahhh!
The narrow passage prevents Hella from jumping up and unleashing a proper tirade. After furiously punching the air twice, her rational brain finally reboots.
Although... her little noggin didn't quite follow that cryptic conversation just now. But she can at least confirm two things:
[Flashback Filter] [WhiteSands Storm]

First, the strange storm surrounding Furor is undeniably an <color=#fb9259>Apostle of Ashes</color>. The city faces imminent destruction, and Hypatia wants Hella to work with the Legion to evacuate all residents from Furor.
[Flashback Filter] [City Center - Daytime]

Second, Hypatia apparently doesn't want her family to know about her plan to ask help from a group from <color=#fb9259>DisCity</color>...? Strange, aren't the Campbells supposed to be the guardians of this city?
As for the third thing...
Just now, when Hypatia confronted Synex, her tone was cold and severe, but Hella could see her hands behind her back, fingers tightly clenched and slightly trembling.
...Just like how tense she looked when she exposed Hella's identity.
[Background: Inside the Coffin]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft, haha, so she was super nervous back then too.
Not one to speak her true feelings, huh... Reminds me of someone I know.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But wait a second... Where the heck am I anyway?!
Hella turns around to look at the pitch-black duct behind her. Unlike the cramped space where she can barely crouch, the passage behind her seems to stretch far into the darkness.
The stone door she used to enter the tunnel is now completely sealed... Does this mean her only option is to go deeper inside?
[Transition for 1 second, sound effect of fabric rustling and something moving in a pocket.]
Something seems to be moving in her pocket. Hella reaches in and pulls out a strange object. With five pointed tips, it looks like a star, but also resembles a tiny doll.

The next moment, the tiny doll activates with a hum and begins to glow. It jumps down from Hella's palm, slightly tilts its head, and performs an elaborate but familiar ceremonial bow with its short, stubby limbs...
So familiar that Hella realizes she just saw someone else make the exact same gesture.
...Hypatia?!
The doll bounces in a circle around Hella, then stops in front of her, nodding, as if confirming her suspicion: Yes, its operator is exactly who you think it is.
It raises its arm, hops a few steps into the darkness, and illuminates the space ahead.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So you want me to follow you? But it gets narrower up ahead. I'd have to crawl through... Hey, if you're so smart, couldn't you just open up that door for me instead? Please?
The doll shakes its head, then hops twice, flashing brighter to emphasize its determination. A cool breeze drifts from the darkness, its source unknown. Hella swallows hard.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...So, I really have to crawl?
The doll nods. It points toward the outside, then dramatically draws a line across its throat before flopping to the ground with a plop, playing dead.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You—!
It's not wrong though. If Hella wants answers to all her questions, the best way forward is to follow Hypatia's directions and find her in person.
Even if it means being crammed into a duct, having to crawl on her hands and knees.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Ahhh fine! I get it!
Politely, Hella gives the tiny doll the finger, then huffily gets into position, preparing to crawl.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Fine, I'll crawl through this stupid pipe!
